axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All required targets, edit/reconnect cases, durable identity, original/unresolved context, retention and read-only export are addressed; all three negative constraints are explicit.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Governing documentation, definitions, relevant implementation/caller/tests, editions and historical exceptions were checked. C-N1/C-N2/C-N3 bound nonmaterial wording and locator limits.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Useful tree/history, deletion-metadata, conflict, reconciliation and annotation mechanisms have relevant alternatives and failure history. Discovery is finite, with no universal recall claim.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: All significant plan decisions and C1-C3 are examined. C1 is a valid predecessor omission and is repaired; owner decisions and mutable editions remain qualified.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Supported identity, transform, connector/region, deletion, ordering, alternatives, privacy, export and validation meaning survive into the self-contained final. No material loss found.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Synthetic histories specify domains and expected semantic invariants separately from convergence. Proposed tests, permission/usability work and measurements remain unexecuted; deployment is not required.

preservation_witnesses.supported_meaning: same-target movement; replacements are distinct; historical context preserved
coordinate frame, original selector, nested mapping and ambiguity boundary retained
thread survives; stale edits do not silently materialize a deleted target
convergence separated from intent; ordering and conflict qualifications retained
roster, cutoff, archive/redaction and returning-peer choices remain visible
semantic context and unresolved threads survive; screenshots are supplemental
proposed tests remain proposals; no deployment or executed merge proof invented

critic_dispositions.assessment: Valid omission, accepted and repaired through repository test inspection.
Correctly retains unknown product facts and policies.
Mutable editions remain disclosed; no implementation pin is falsely claimed.

items: whole repositories and all history beyond consequential definitions/callers/tests/fixes
unseen workloads and universal discovery recall
future component execution, deployment, access-control and usability outcomes
actual user/device/membership/privacy-policy facts not in brief
private routing identity, direct native transcripts and unavailable billing telemetry

coverage_definition: COMPLETE means the entire declared planning brief, exact plan, all available stage science and consequential obligations/claims were assessed at finite depth. It is not universal correctness or deployed behavior. No decisive early-stop shortcut was used.
